In storytelling, the đàn tranh accompanies tales of Vietnamese mythology and historical events, adding depth to narratives with its unique sound. In spiritual ceremonies, the instrument plays a role in invoking ancestral spirits and conveying messages of peace and harmony. Its history dates back several centuries, making it an integral part of Vietnamese music, often featured in both formal and informal settings to convey emotions and spiritual significance beyond musical accompaniment.
